en: Color postcard showing a person water‑skiing on a large lake with wake in the foreground. On the opposite shore are rows of trees and two large modernist resort hotels/apartment blocks. Clear blue sky with scattered clouds. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and postmarks indicating Mamaia and București. Printed caption mentions water‑skiing on Lake Siutghiol.
